questions.prompt: What should this goal package contain?
questions.description: Setup output only. Execution is a later /goal or the project workflow.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Parent goal.md + facts.md + plan.md, one plans/<workstream>.md per useful item, backlog.md for nits, and .grok/workflows/e2e-refine.rhai in this repo. This setup stays Plannotator; the workflow runs the plans after /goal.

options.label: Parent goal.md, facts.md, plan.md
plans/<workstream>.md for each first-class item
Project workflow .grok/workflows/e2e-refine.rhai
backlog.md for nits / speculative extras

questions.description: Dirty files already exist under apps/docs and packages/core codegen. Full build-out, not a stub.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Finish docs-full-catalog-playground as a full playground + generator + widget/bit/theme libs. Ship the visual README from existing stills/draft. Keep Marketplace leftover as an operator plan. Fixtures default; optional live including full HTML scrape. POST /api/preview stays layout preview, not an embed API.

options.label: Full docs app: playground, generator, widget/bit/theme libs

Leftover Marketplace listing operator steps as a plan

questions.prompt: After the four shipped sources, what new product ids should the inventory plan?
questions.description: Ranking is integrations-first. N is the elbow where the next source is clearly less useful. New packs are OpenSpec-first.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Rank new integrations; take N until diminishing returns. For each survivor, plan the pack, widgets, and bits that source needs. Also plan any extra Takumi-safe bits inspired by shadcn/ui (no dialog/toast/popover). One OpenSpec change per workstream.

options.label: Top N new integrations until the next one has diminishing usefulness
For each source: corresponding pack + widgets + bits if needed
Any useful Takumi-safe bits (shadcn-inspired, not web overlays)
One OpenSpec change per workstream

questions.prompt: Named palettes (47 already ship). What belongs in this bundle?
questions.description: The docs themes library is part of wave 1. This is the remaining product fork.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Wave 1 documents and playgrounds all 47 (contrast, /generate/themes). Add a new family only if a planned widget needs a named flavor that is not in the catalog. Do not uncap palettes the way bits were uncapped.

options.label: Complete the 47 in the themes lib; add a family only if a widget needs it
Also plan the next 3 palette families from author ideate even without a hole
Plan every useful extra family the themes audit wants
No new families; only document the existing 47

questions.description: The bundle still plans everything. Waves are for the workflow and /goal.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Wave 1: docs/README/Marketplace closeout. Wave 2: max-widen the four shipped integrations (parallel). Wave 3: elbow new sources, each OpenSpec change in parallel.

options.label: Wave 1 docs/README → wave 2 widen four → wave 3 new sources
Wave 1 docs/README plus widen four → wave 2 new sources
New sources first, then widen, then docs
